title: Street Name History
description: *Street Name History* is a **web tool** that takes any street you search for and shows **every name it carries across languages**, the **former names** it has shed through history, and **who or what it was named after**. It answers a surprisingly hard question — "what has this street been called, and why?" — by pulling the answer together live in the browser.

I directed the concept and the **multi-source data architecture**: geocoding and all multilingual/historical name tags come from **OpenStreetMap** (via Nominatim), etymology and entity detail from **Wikidata**, and dated name timelines from **OpenHistoricalMap**, with the enrichment sources layered on non-blocking so the core result always renders. The pure logic — URL-as-state, OSM tag classification, and each API's request/response contract — is **TDD-covered** with Bun.

The result is a keyless, serverless tool that runs entirely on static hosting and degrades gracefully: coverage depends on what mappers have contributed, so it surfaces whatever exists and says plainly when a street's history simply isn't recorded yet.
